rationale.repository: Keep source, tests, governance, compact evidence, deterministic runtime data and the exact static release closure.
rationale.localOnly: Keep raw, private, scratch, OCR and rebuild-only authoring binaries on the local machine and out of Git.
rationale.pages: Publish only the exact release-plan closure; responsive WebP derivatives remain because the browser needs them at runtime.
rationale.history: This policy changes the current tree only. Existing Git history is not rewritten.
